description.value: Your sabotage takes effect when the time is right. When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Disable a Device], you can delay the device from becoming disabled for up to 24 hours or until someone attempts to use the device. In most cases, creatures have a chance to detect that the device is disabled only if they use the [[/act seek]] action to attempt Perception checks against your Thievery DC. If you rolled a critical success on your Thievery check to Disable a Device, other creatures can't figure out the device will become disabled, and you can safely activate the device without triggering or ending the effect of Delayed Disable.
